top.title: Dubai property buyers get keys months ahead of time
top.teaser: Dubai: Imagine buying an off-plan apartment in Dubai with a promise to receive the keys in three years, only to find your new home ready nine months ahead of schedule. For investors, that could mean earning rental income earlier, while end-users could move in sooner and potentially save thousands of dirhams in rent.
